chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late fifties wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a white headscarf with small blue flowers, round face, determined frown
chars.SON: SON: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, trimmed black beard, thin and slightly pale, wearing a burgundy hoodie and dark grey jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modern Moroccan apartment living room in Rabat, seen from the doorway: MOM crouches mid-act pulling the cushions off a beige sofa and peering behind it, face clearly visible, suspicious searching expression. Head-to-waist framing, main subject centered, calm background at the edges. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Daytime street in front of a modern apartment building in Rabat: SON, recovered but still thin, walks quickly toward the entrance with MOM beside him, MOM gesturing angrily with one hand as she talks. Both faces visible, subjects centered. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Apartment building stairwell: MOM climbs the stairs ahead, turning back and ranting furiously, wagging her finger, while SON follows behind looking tired and embarrassed. Faces visible, subjects centered. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SON has just opened the front door of his apartment and stands frozen in the doorway looking at an empty silent living room, surprised; MOM peeks over his shoulder with narrowed eyes. Faces visible, subjects centered. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Apartment bedroom: MOM kneels and reaches deep under the bed and into a low wardrobe corner, pulling things out with a determined face, while SON stands behind her in the doorway watching anxiously. Faces visible, subjects centered. 2D animated illustration style.
